headline: State Bank of Pakistan notes Middle East conflict aggravated inflation and rates
summary: The State Bank of Pakistan's annual report stated that regional Middle East conflict worsened the country's external balance and inflation, necessitating a 100-basis-point policy rate increase.
why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets benchmark interest rates to balance inflation control with debt servicing costs under IMF program surveillance.

impacts.name: Pakistan Policy Rate
impacts.why: The central bank highlighted the prior 100 bps rate hike required to absorb commodity price shocks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
